failure_summary.description: Agents returned a full phrase or category, or a truth judgment, instead of the implicit answer requested by the clue.
Answers differed from the expected surface form in title spacing or grammatical number.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already instructs agents to identify the requested answer slot, avoid truth judgments unless requested, supply only the missing component, and use canonical forms with appropriate grammar. These failures are covered by those rules, so adding similar guidance would duplicate existing content rather than address a new gap.
